To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the citation-based summarization task is challenging but not impossible to address, and (ii) the use of the citation graph to improve summarization performance is not straightforward and requires a careful selection of the graph nodes to be used.

(i) unsupervised sentence matching systems can be competitive with the state-of-the-art, (ii) the citation type can be predicted from citation context with high accuracy, and (iii) citation-based summarizers are able to extract the main contributions of scientific papers.

(1) unsupervised systems for sentence matching can outperform supervised approaches, (2) citation-based summarization is a challenging task that requires further research, and (3) the CL-Sci-Summ 2017 dataset is a good resource to develop new methods for this task.
